notes:
Interviews are easier to follow.

Every interview now leads with its round number in a highlighted badge. The
earlier rounds you read before your own sit in coloured frames — green when
that round was cleared, red when rejected, blue when scheduled — and your own
write-up is a separate "Your assessment" section, so it is always clear which
part is yours to fill in.

Candidates from HR consultancies.

A candidate sent in by an HR consultancy is marked "via" that consultancy. The
consultancy takes Round 1 itself, so HR sees that round read-only and schedules
Round 2 onwards as usual.

Current in-hand CTC.

A candidate's current in-hand CTC is now recorded beside the expected CTC —
when adding or editing a candidate, and on the candidate's details.
